name: Aurelius Collective Gauze Tail-Wrap Trouser
description: Wide-leg linen-gauze trousers in off-white with rust-dyed block print at the hem, cut with a full-width rear tail channel and adjustable drawstring closure. The open-back tail passage is lined in soft mesh that won't trap heat or chafe geneware modifications. Breathable enough for 35C humidity, elegant enough for Tier 3 client meetings.
functionality: Full rear tail-channel with mesh lining, wide-leg cut for airflow, moisture-wicking waistband.
what_it_says: You have geneware and you've stopped dressing around it — you dress for it.
story_hooks: The block print pattern is a specific artisan stamp from a collective workshop that burned down last quarter.
Someone hemmed the tail channel shorter than standard — this was made for a specific person.
